sections.Profile:
"Black Velvet" is a solid-state cocktail-style pinball machine released by Game Plan Inc. in May 1978. Designed by Ed Cebula with artwork by Jim Sullivan, it accommodates up to four players.

- Manufacturer: Game Plan Inc.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, Cocktail, Original Theme, 1970s, Solid State, Playfield Gimmick
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Jim Sullivan
- Design: Ed Cebula
